name: One More at the River
description: One More is a lively riverfront venue renowned for its relaxed and friendly atmosphere. It offers a variety of entertainment options including live bands, karaoke nights, and open mic events. The venue features a scenic patio facing the Alabama River, a jukebox, pool tables, and a dance floor, making it a perfect spot for socializing, enjoying good drinks, and experiencing a vibrant community vibe. Its welcoming staff and scenic views make it stand out as a local favorite for entertainment and gatherings.
